tasks.title: Repair private page viewer isolation, PWA API exclusion and deletion freshness
acceptance: Working/review copies remain viewer-scoped memory only; logout, identity changes and late responses cannot expose a previous copy; language switching retains data identity.
Generated production Service Worker never caches or replays API image/video/document requests; legacy runtime migration preserves current precache and unrelated caches.
Deletion clears every page-copy variant and affected lists without late refill; failed deletion preserves data; local type/build and targeted regression checks cover the repair.

evidence.source: Issue #832; isolated codex/832-page-cache-safety publication branch based on 4ed35f68, with unrelated audit evidence excluded
evidence.environment: Local Windows/Node 24 and headless Microsoft Edge/Playwright; intercepted page APIs and a synthetic local file/API server for the generated production SW
evidence.check: 11 page/http/PWA cache regressions; 30 existing bilingual/locale/navigation/adapter checks; pageCache.browser.cjs covers view, review, group preview, editor, logout/language switching and deletion/reload; pwaCache.browser.cjs covers activation migration, private cache exclusion/offline rejection and public image/video offline replay
evidence.outcome: All 11 new and 30 related existing checks pass. Browser scenarios pass for working/review copies, group preview, editor, logout/language switching, failed/successful deletion and reload. The final rebuilt production SW passes legacy-cache migration, private image/video/document exclusion and offline rejection, and public image/video offline replay. Final application/config type checks and production build pass. All targeted checks and both browser suites were rerun successfully on the isolated publication tree; ship-dist contains its rebuilt SW. Existing churchLife import, Package source-string, web-dialog false-positive and personal-task fixture failures were reconfirmed separately and are outside this repair.
evidence.limitations: Synthetic accounts/APIs only; no live backend/database permissions, deployed edge, real-account acceptance or iOS device verification. Draft publication authorized by /shipit; no deployment. Build/browser artifacts: C:/Data/Alife/Temp/page-cache-fix-20261010.
